concerns.text: FR-002 specifies a “permutation test (target‑permutation, RMSE change as statistic)” to compare the Full Model with the Null Model. Target‑permutation shuffles the response variable, destroying all predictive signal, so it cannot isolate the contribution of interaction features. As written the requirement cannot be deterministically verified because the null hypothesis is ill‑defined.

SC-002 requires significance (α ≤ 0.05) from a permutation test comparing Full vs Null models but does not state whether the p‑value is the upper‑tail (ΔRMSE ≥ observed) or lower‑tail (ΔRMSE ≤ observed). The direction is ambiguous, making the success criterion unmeasurable without further clarification.
